description: No credential or login required. Upload one file for a later Google tool call and get an `upload_id` back; pass that value to the tool that uses the file. Nothing is sent to Google here. action is the action ID of the tool that will use the file (its tool name with dots instead of double underscores). purpose is one of ads_image.marketing, ads_image.square_marketing, ads_image.portrait_marketing, ads_image.square_logo, ads_image.landscape_logo, youtube.thumbnail, youtube.caption; an action refuses a purpose it does not take. content_base64 is the file bytes as base64 (standard or URL-safe, padding optional). The file must be at most 5,120,000 bytes, and the image or caption checks of the purpose run on the decoded bytes. The file is kept for 7 days and then deleted automatically. If the staged-file cap is reached, ask the user to discard an unused file with the REST API (DELETE /v1/google/uploads/{upload_id}), or wait for the 7-day expiry. 호출마다 토큰 1소진 입력 자료를 XBOSS에 저장합니다. 기존 기관 실행 권한과 확인 절차가 적용됩니다.

action.description: Action ID of the tool that will use this file.

content_base64.description: The file bytes as base64 (standard or URL-safe, padding optional).

file_name.description: Display name of the file. The format is read from the bytes, not from this name.

purpose.description: What the file is for. The action must take this purpose.
